apps.name: Phyllanthus & Rattans Identification Kit
apps.origin: Indian Barcode of Life kit (DBT, Government of India), 2010. Built by ATREE Bangalore, UAS Bangalore and BSI Kolkata.
apps.credit: Proprietary right holder: Dr. K.N. Ganeshaiah · Updated in 2026 by Dr. Sachin A. Rosario

editions.label: Version 2 – Updated (2026)
editions.summary: Names updated to the Catalogue of Life (2010 names kept), GenBank DNA barcode records, guided key, India distribution map with GIS export, comparison and glossary.
editions.gis: Exports localities as GeoJSON, KML and CSV for QGIS or ArcGIS (desktop and published web version).

downloads.note: Installs beside Version 1. No administrator password.
Runs straight from a folder or pen drive.
Any computer. Extract, then double-click Open Kit.html.
